objective: One bounded read-only operational cross-section of the current SparkBrain scheduler-delay pattern, using a fresh live scheduler timing snapshot plus durable worker timestamps to test whether the prior broad queue-pressure diagnosis persists or instead localizes to a deterministic phase/role.

trigger_source.new_information_available: A fresh 02:00-02:25 JST scheduler cross-section is available, including an exact durable MAIN lease started_at/blocked_at pair.

ownership_generations_at_start.relay: NO_SEPARATE_ACTIVE_RELAY_OWNERSHIP; MAIN lease is BLOCKED pending fresh Analyst review

allowed_actions: Read live scheduler definitions and recent run timestamps
Compare nominal phase to coarse live last-run timestamps and exact durable timestamps where available
Persist one NON_EVIDENTIARY Utility result and terminal Utility state
forbidden_actions: Any scientific workflow dispatch or experiment
Any use of consumed/protected scientific identity
stop_condition: Stop after one fresh cross-section classification; stop earlier on assignment/ownership supersession or collision.
